_comment: TANUH MViT2 oral-cancer fold ensemble (model6/model8/model8-2 → mvit2_fold1_6/fold1_8/fold2_8) on ONNX Runtime Mobile (engine=onnx). Preprocessing reconciled to the authoritative Python cv2 reference (integration doc §2, Tejashree/IISc), TANUH-confirmed 9 Jul: BGR channel order to the model; EXIF orientation applied before preprocessing (native, EdgeModelModule); bicubic resize to 256 (hand-rolled bicubicResize — NO OpenCV, 16 KB Play blocker); gray-world mean→128, clip; round to 1 decimal (np.round(x,1)); uint8 cast round-to-nearest (convertScaleAbs); ÷255 only, no mean/std. Image verdict = unanimous AND across the 3 folds (combine=unanimous-and); per-model sigmoid-binary at 0.5. Case-level OR is the form/rule layer (ops#231).
